reward_earning_rules: Transactions of ₹ 400 to ₹ 4,000 on fuel done through the credit card will not attract any surcharge.
On every ₹ 100 spent with the credit card, 4 Reward Points will be given worth ₹ 1.
You will get an instant 10% discount on the dining bills at 1,200 restaurants partners if payment is made through the credit card.
You will get a discount of 5-10% on car rentals outside India.
monthly_capping_rules: Subject to monthly category/accelerated caps and standard MCC exclusions under issuer T&C.

milestone_slabs: There is a joining and annual fee on the card of ₹ 250 but it can be waived off if the previous year’s transaction on the card amount is more than ₹ 1 Lakh.

lounge_access_detailed.no_lounge_note: This card does not provide complimentary domestic airport, international airport, or railway lounge access.

benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Union Bank of India Visa International Signature Credit Card is a credit card option from Union Bank of India suited for fuel users.
highlights: There is a joining and annual fee on the card of ₹ 250 but it can be waived off if the previous year’s transaction on the card amount is more than ₹ 1 Lakh.
You will get 50 days of interest-free credit period, wherein no interest on the outstanding amount will be charged for 50 days.
The outstanding amount on the credit card can be paid by cash, cheque or online payment.
Transactions of ₹ 400 to ₹ 4,000 on fuel done through the credit card will not attract any surcharge.
All the transactions through the card are intimated to you via SMS or email. The transactions are also secured through the platform of VISA.
milestone_benefits: There is a joining and annual fee on the card of ₹ 250 but it can be waived off if the previous year’s transaction on the card amount is more than ₹ 1 Lakh.
dining_benefits: You will get an instant 10% discount on the dining bills at 1,200 restaurants partners if payment is made through the credit card.
insurance_cover: This credit card also offers Accidental death insurance of ₹ 6 Lakh and air accident insurance of ₹ 10 Lakh.
